name: @wyrd-company/manifold-host-cli
description: The Manifold host CLI, a companion binary installed on each environment.

scripts.build:targets: for target in linux-x64 linux-arm64 darwin-arm64 windows-x64; do bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=bun-$target --outfile dist/$target/manifold-host || exit 1; done
